columns.name: sku
columns.description: SKU identity of the filed stock (AC1). NOT NULL per PI2.

columns.name: location
columns.description: Physical location of the filed stock (AC1). NOT NULL per PI2.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Filed stock level (AC1). NOT NULL per PI2; CHECK >= 0 per PI3.

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Combined tracking code encoding location, batch, and serial, stored exactly as supplied (AC2). Optional; not every filing supplies one.

schema_changes.detail: Create stock_records with id (PK), sku NOT NULL, location NOT NULL, quantity integer NOT NULL, inventory_code text nullable; composite UNIQUE (sku, location) backing the in-place upsert (AC3/PI1); CHECK quantity >= 0 (PI3). All columns NOT NULL per PI2 except optional inventory_code.
schema_changes.migration_note: Additive create_table only; no existing table is altered or dropped, so pre-existing inventory rows are untouched and downgrade() drops stock_records cleanly (PI4). The unique (sku, location) constraint lets the repository upsert (ON CONFLICT) for repeat filings.
